label: There cannot be no holder of another that is MOTION_3 held in no respect
paraphrase: Analyst conclusion, attribution deferred, the MOTION_3 sibling of the absolute First-Way conclusion c1b68c21: it is impossible that there be no f that presently actualizes some other x in some respect (holding, definition 6ab9a832) and is MOTION_3 held (definition ea1904bc) in no respect. It is the First-Way reading with being moved read as MOTION_3 holding and moving read as holding another (firstUnheldHolder_iff_reading). It says nothing of potency, necessity, uniqueness or God, and nothing about MOTION_1 motion.
